source.citation: Ganesh, A., Hauert, S., & Valla, E. (2025). Consensus in the weighted voter model with noise-free and noisy observations. Swarm Intelligence, 19(3), 173-214.

scope: Complete graph K_N, N to infinity with k fixed; exponential signalling periods; bounded rates with separated supports 0<a_-<=a_+<b_-<=b_+<infinity (every favourable rate strictly below every resident rate).

claims.statement: For a constant favourable rate a and any initial resident law nu, lim alpha_k(N;nu) = 1-(1-c_nu)^k with c_nu = [1 + a int_0^inf exp(-int_0^t (b_nu(s)-a) ds) dt]^{-1}, b_nu(t) the mean rate of the resident reset process started from nu.

If the resident law F is not a point mass, b_F(t) > lambda for all t>=0 and c_F > 1-a/lambda, so the fresh-start limit strictly exceeds the conjectured 1-(a/lambda)^k. Conjecture 2 is false as stated whenever resident rates vary.
a=1, F=(delta_2+delta_6)/2: c_F = 0.702032053928212... (certified to 30 digits), versus conjectured 2/3.
At fixed harmonic mean lambda and minimum resident rate b_0>a, sup c_F = (lambda-a)/(lambda-a+a e^{-(lambda/b_0-1)}), not attained.

Over all constant a and resident laws with compact support in (a,infinity), the supremum of the single-founder underestimate c_F-(1-a/lambda) is Delta(xi_*) in (0.2733554343215126, 0.2733554343215181), not attained.
With resident rate ratio bbar/b_0 <= 3, the proved ceiling (43) is below 8.27 points (tends to 8.27 as b_0/a->1; 7.77 at b_0/a=1.25). At ratio 10 the ceiling tends to about 22.5 points.
After burn-in tau, 0 <= c_tau - gamma/lambda <= L D e^{-b_0 tau}; the k-founder probability error is at most k(a/lambda)^{k-1} L D e^{-b_0 tau}.
For a general favourable law F_A, lim alpha_k = 1-[int e_0 d nu^A]^k with e_0 from the backward equations (47)-(49) of a multitype time-inhomogeneous branching process.

Fresh residents give a strictly larger limit than equilibrium residents for every initial favourable law when F is not a point mass; with nu^A=F_A the fresh limit strictly exceeds the conjectured 1-pi^k.

claims.evidence: written proof; exact identity check for four laws
claims.statement: From the equilibrium start (nu=mu, nu^A=G_A), lim alpha_k = 1-(E T_B / E T_A)^k = 1-(lambda m_A)^{-k}.
Under the equilibrium start simulated by the source, the limit strictly exceeds the conjectured 1-pi^k whenever F_A is not a point mass; equality for constant favourable rate (equation (7)).

claims.evidence: floating ODE integration, not certified; strict inequality proved by Corollary 5
claims.statement: Favourable rates 1/2 or 1, resident rates 2 or 6 (each 1/2), fresh start: limit 0.7842272... versus conjectured (3+sqrt 37)/12 = 0.7568969...; equilibrium start 7/9 exactly.

confirms: Conjecture 2's formula under the equilibrium start for a constant favourable rate (equation (7))
Theorem 5 of the source (the stationary branching calculation) is untouched
refutes: Conjecture 2 as stated (fresh initial samples), whenever resident rates vary
Conjecture 2's formula under the equilibrium start when favourable rates vary
